## Need to downsize your Kolkata home and don’t want to lose your precious heirlooms? Storage in Kolkata can help you hold on to everything you value, without the necessity of downsizing.


**[Self-storage units in Kolkata](https://stownest.com/self-storage-kolkata)** help members of the family keep their inheritance and memories safe as the rest of the family downsizes from the old/ancestral home. Storage units provide this convenience with no need for a new, larger home because they help hold onto memories without the burden of physical space.


## **What Downsizing Really Means in an Old Kolkata Home**


**[Downsizing an old family home](https://stownest.com/blog/household-storage-service-kolkata-guide)** can mean much more than simply decluttering. For most of us, decluttering our old family homes means more than just removing old junk and bedding our furniture. For us in Kolkata, our ancestral homes encompass much more than just a structure built of four walls.It encompasses the brass idols that come out for the Durga Puja, the wedding sarees which have been tucked away for many years, old photos, the jewellery box of the grandmother, and much older furniture.


Moving into a smaller and more compact flat from the house that was the family heirloom is an emotional change that most families would say outweighs the physical change. Every item, no matter how small, becomes a sentiment of someone or something. Many would say leaving items that are rarely used behind is not right.Ancestral property storage and heirloom storage do this to protect that which used to be a home, it does not hold more belongings from enlarging a home.


## **A Smaller Home, But Not a Smaller History**


Deciding what to part with is easy. The hard part is accepting that almost nothing actually feels like it can be thrown away. A smaller place has limited room for a full trunk of Puja items, heavy wooden furniture, boxes of photographs and letters, etc. Keeping them still is not protecting them. Untouched items in a small space collect dust just like in a large space. They still deteriorate due to the effects of the environment.


Most families are left with two less-than-favorable options. The first is to get creative in purging what matters. The second is squeezing into smaller living spaces.


## **How This Actually Affects Kolkata Families**


There are a few different ways this shows up. First, on the emotional side of things, the constant feeling of having to prioritize what is worth lugging over plays an active role in making an already stressful and time-consuming event so much more guilt-ridden. Additionally, smaller houses make horrible conditions for storage. Heirlooms end up shoved under the bed, piled up in storage lofts, and even left in damp, dark, feeble storage spaces. A lot of families end up renting bigger flats than what they need just to avoid the problem. What they’re doing is trading the bigger, better storage for even more guilt.


## **Keep What's Important, Store What's Not**


With the help of self-storage, people can easily save their memories, pictures and personal belongings. There is no need to cram special heirlooms into a jam-packed dwelling or unnecessarily move to a larger residence for the sole purpose of having more storage. **[Storage units](https://stownest.com/self-storage)** are built with special climates and provide an alternative to having damp belongings stuck in a stuffy, cluttered residence.


A storage service provides package and ship storage throughout the entire process of moving from one location to another, which can be stressful and emotional. Items are transported by a team to the new storage location, and nothing is left behind because there is no need to move across the city. Every item is tracked and is of significant importance when it comes to stored irreplaceable items, including family photographs and special jewelry. Finally, when the celebration of Durga Puja comes around or when it is time to use the special family silver, there is no need to conduct a search through stored items in the loft.


## **This Actually Helps Who**


Some families in Kolkata would benefit the most from this. First, many families leave their large inherited family homes and move to smaller apartments. Second, families like to store utensils and groceries they use and things they are required to keep during festivals, without cluttering their apartment. Lastly, families are particular about keeping heirlooms and furniture.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. How does self storage facilitate downsizing in Kolkata?**


If you don't have enough space to store all your belongings at your new smaller home, self storage allows you the flexibility of storing your belongings securely.


**2. Are fragile and sentimental valuables safe to store?**


Valuables are safe as long as the storage service has a system to individually track stored belongings and also has sufficient insurance coverage. Additionally, **[StowNest](https://stownest.com/)** provides 24/7 monitoring and coverage worth ₹2.5 lakhs.


**3. Do I need to transport valuables to a facility?**


No, items are collected from your home, which can be a huge relief during tough downsizing moves.


**4. Is self storage a viable option to prevent renting a larger home?**


Quite possibly. With self storage, you do not have to pay to store items across an entire extra room, which would otherwise be the case if you rented a larger home.
